purpose: Pictures of the three selected a2 outcomes: real saved MIMo states (earlier goal, actual start, actual end) and the per-part forecasts (first and selected) drawn as independent markers over the real start, with the arm fitter's connected arm as a labelled illustration
owner: the builder render program, for the report (the overseer retains the HTML)
decision: the overseer, the operator's proxy, a2-saved-record-repair-diagnosis-20261023, item 3 (three selected examples rendered from the saved data)
camera_rule: One camera per example, the same for all five panels: the existing renderer's front view (BODY_VIEWS "front": azimuth 180 degrees, elevation -8 degrees) in the start pose's upper-body coordinates (_Body.set_frame(start): the renderer's trunk body at the start; x toward the belly, y toward the infant's left, z toward the head; the infant faces the camera, so the picture's right is the infant's left), placed by _Body.fit so that both arms, the head, the chest and the upper body at each pose drawn and every drawn marker within 1 m of the start's trunk fit the 480 x 560 pixel picture, at the fitted distance times 1.18 (render_learning.py's factor). The goal and the end are drawn in the start's coordinates, so a move of the whole body shows as a shift.

caption_template.common: {example}, body {body}, the command planned at model step {plan}. Panel {n} of 5, {panel}:
caption_template.goal: a real MIMo render of the saved joint positions of model step {goal_step} ({goal_meaning}), {goal_relation}. Not a prediction and not a fitted pose. Green squares: the goal palm points, from {goal_source}. Orange rings: this record's own palm points, {ring} from the green squares.{lag} Shoulder, elbow and palm point are the origins of the upper-arm, forearm and hand bodies; the palm point, the hand body's origin, lies inside the palm. Camera: the front view fixed on the start pose's upper body, the same for all five panels.
caption_template.start: a real MIMo render of the saved joint positions of model step {start_step} ({start_meaning}). Palm point to goal palm point (green squares): left {L}, right {R}.{gap}{lag} Not a prediction.
caption_template.prediction: not a simulator state. Purple dots: the forecast world position of each arm part (shoulder, elbow, palm point) for {which}; purple diamond: the forecast chest. Each forecast part is that part's world pose after the command's 5 model steps (250 ms), at the actual end ({end_step}, 5 model steps after the start record). Each part is forecast separately, so no line joins them; each purple arrow shows the forecast direction of that part's long axis (3.5 cm long, not a limb). They are drawn over the real start render, faded. The fitted arm, grey rings joined by a dashed grey line, is the forward kinematics of one set of the arm's 7 hinge angles inside their ranges, the set the fitter's solve returned as nearest the three forecast parts, placed on the forecast chest; a fitted illustration, not a result. Red lines: forecast part to the fitted arm's place for it: {mismatch}. Forecast palm point to goal palm point: left {L}, right {R}.{to_end}{same}
caption_template.end: a real MIMo render of the saved joint positions of model step {end_step} ({end_meaning}), {end_relation}. Palm point to goal palm point (green squares): left {L}, right {R}.{gap}{lag} Not a prediction.
caption_template.tail: Every distance printed is a straight-line distance in space, not a length on the picture. The infant faces the camera, so the picture's right is the infant's left.

typical_improving.rule: among the usable outcomes whose measured pose error at the order's end is below its start (actual_pose_error.end.sum < actual_pose_error.start.sum, the reading's numbers in the forecast's units), sorted by the actual decrease (start sum minus end sum) ascending, ties by (model step, body): the outcome at index floor((n - 1) / 2), the median-ranked one (the lower middle one when n is even)

analysis_meanings.goal: the world record s - age - 1 = 496196, the body's state when the goal moment s - age = 496197 (age 143 model steps, inferred from the goal ring's age, its basis prior_history_unverified) read the goal pose; the stored goal pose lags that state by one 5 ms physics substep (it is read from the body positions and orientations MuJoCo leaves at the start of its last substep), so the two differ by that substep's motion: stored_pose_gap_cm (the largest position difference over the 25 non-gaze rows), stored_pose_gap_deg (the largest turn over those rows, degrees) and palm_gap_cm (the two palm rows) are the measured gap between the record's rebuilt pose and the stored pose (null when the goal join did not read that record); qpos given only when that record is confirmed by content (LAST_SUBSTEP_NOTE: (i) every row within twice its storage bound plus the previous record's storage bound plus the row's motion over the model step, and (ii) no neighbouring record nearer the stored goal pose beyond the two records' largest storage bounds)
analysis_meanings.start: the world record s - 1, the body's state when the plan step s read its start pose; the stored start pose lags that state by one 5 ms physics substep (it is read from the body positions and orientations MuJoCo leaves at the start of its last substep), so the two differ by that substep's motion: stored_pose_gap_cm (the largest position difference over the 25 non-gaze rows), stored_pose_gap_deg (the largest turn over those rows, degrees) and palm_gap_cm (the two palm rows) are the measured gap between the record's rebuilt pose and the stored pose
analysis_meanings.end: the world record s + 4 (hold 5 model steps), the body's state when model step s + 5 read the end pose; the stored end pose lags that state by one 5 ms physics substep (it is read from the body positions and orientations MuJoCo leaves at the start of its last substep), so the two differ by that substep's motion: stored_pose_gap_cm (the largest position difference over the 25 non-gaze rows), stored_pose_gap_deg (the largest turn over those rows, degrees) and palm_gap_cm (the two palm rows) are the measured gap between the record's rebuilt pose and the stored pose

pose_error.meaning: the pose error in the forecast's units: position = mean over the 25 non-gaze handles and 3 axes of (cm / 1.80)^2, rotation = the same of (degrees / 11.0)^2, sum = both; start and end measured, first and selected forecast

optional_fields.meaning: analysis_meanings, pose_error and analysis_note are the analysis file's own text, kept here only: captions and drawn text use this program's wording
